method: headless chromium (chrome-devtools-axi), two static file servers over 127.0.0.1 serving the site/ tree at each revision, no live network

before.note: site/app/map_runtime.mjs and site/land_map_authority_handoff.mjs as landed by LM-14 (PR #1548) — the compact handoff exposed only the top-level available/partial/unavailable state plus raw procedure_id/stage_id

after.note: adds procedure_state (known/mixed/unknown/stale/missing), a normative role line, and a typed next_action affordance to the same compact handoff

harness.description: A static page that imports the real site/land_map_model.mjs and site/app/map_runtime.mjs modules unmodified and calls the production landMapSelectionHTML() against three fixture summaries, so the captured markup is exactly what Map renders for a selection — not a mock.
harness.route_emulated: /browse/zoning/?boro=Queens&stage=public_review&view=map (selection surface only; no live network, no server, no data fetch)
harness.i18n: site/i18n.js loaded for real English copy

known.assertion: procedure_state=known, role and a dated next action all render; none are derived from the marker's position or method

mixed.assertion: typed as procedure_state=mixed with its own copy — LM-14 rendered this identically to the unknown specimen as a bare 'partial'; no next-action date is shown

unknown.assertion: typed as procedure_state=unknown, distinct from mixed; an explicitly checked-and-none opportunity states no next action is published rather than inventing one

observed_delta: Before: mixed and unknown specimens both render only the word 'partial' plus raw procedure_id/stage ids — visually indistinguishable from each other and carrying no next-action information. After: each specimen gets its own procedure_state copy ("known"/"mixed procedure"/"procedure is not resolved"), a normative role line only when one is supplied, and an explicit next-action line that never shows a date unless published_next_opportunity.status is exactly "published".
